tasks.gr12-black-consciousness-movement-t1: Topic: Black Consciousness Movement. Cover Steve Biko, SASO, psychological liberation, black pride, self-reliance, community programmes, state repression, and the movement's influence on youth resistance in the 1970s. Ask Grade 12 learners to interpret sources, explain concepts, and evaluate significance.
tasks.gr12-soweto-uprising-t1: Topic: Soweto Uprising. Cover Bantu Education, the Afrikaans Medium Decree, student organisation, the protest of 16 June 1976, police shootings, Hector Pieterson, the spread of revolt, exile, and the uprising's local and international significance. Ask Grade 12 learners to analyse causes, consequences, and historical interpretations.
tasks.gr12-trade-unions-and-the-udf-t1: Topic: Trade Unions and the UDF. Cover the Durban strikes of 1973, the growth of independent black trade unions, worker power, civics and youth organisations, the formation of the UDF in 1983, campaigns against apartheid reforms, and links to the wider mass democratic movement. Ask Grade 12 learners to explain continuity and change in internal resistance.
tasks.gr12-independence-in-congo-and-tanzania-: Topic: Independence in Congo and Tanzania. Cover Belgian rule in the Congo, independence in 1960, Lumumba, Katanga secession, UN intervention, Mobutu, Tanganyika's path to independence, Julius Nyerere, the union with Zanzibar, ujamaa, and post-colonial challenges such as weak economies, Cold War interference, and nation-building. Ask Grade 12 learners to compare case studies.
